messages:
Eve Park: Quick heads-up — found a handful of 404s in the Japanese runtime samples page this morning. spotted on staging and prod :frowning:
Maria Chen: ugh ok can you paste the exact URL?
Eve Park: https://docs.redwood.ai/ja/runtime/examples/llm-batch-run.md
Eve Park: staging returns 200 but prod is 404, and the sample assets (curl snippets) 403 when fetched directly. unsure if it's a localization path change or CDN shortlink rot
Maria Chen: thanks. @docs-bot can you run a link-scan for that path and show redirect trace? :eyes:
docs-bot: link-scan started for /ja/runtime/examples/llm-batch-run.md — found missing asset: /assets/samples/llm/example-1.json -> 403 (S3 origin). Full log: https://internal.ci/scan/1733339000
Eve Park: the sample JSON is the main blocker — client engineers hit it during integration tests
Tim O'Leary: I can take this. quick triage: if it's S3 permission, we rehost to docs-cdn and update path; otherwise add a redirect from old shortlink
Maria Chen: if Tim is on it, can you also add a tiny note in the ja runtime guide TOC so users know we're patching? saves support pings
Tim O'Leary: yep. plan: 1) create a rehost PR for example-1.json to docs-cdn 2) update md to reference new path and add a 1-line TODO banner for ja 3) run link-scan before merge
Tim O'Leary: pinging @deploy-bot to schedule a quick staging deploy after PR
deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy for branch/docs/rehost-llm-sample at 1733339200 — will post results
Eve Park: amazing, thanks Tim :pray:
Maria Chen: FYI I'll open a tiny CR to update the ja TOC wording and add you as reviewer
Tim O'Leary: perfect. target to merge within today. leaving a short checklist in the PR body for QA.
Eve Park: awesome — lmk when it's merged and I'll run the integration tests again.
